name: AiInsight
description: A panel that surfaces AI-generated insights derived from operational data, KPIs, or statistics. Each message carries a title, a description, and a variant that communicates its importance level (info, warning, critical, success). With a single message the panel is static; with two or more messages a chevron toggle appears in the header so the user can collapse and expand the list.

props.name: messages
props.description: Array of messages to display. Each message has a title, description, and variant. A single message renders a static panel; two or more messages enable the collapsible toggle.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open/closed state of the panel when it is collapsible (i.e. when messages.length > 1). Has no effect when there is only one message.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn() on the outer panel element.

accessibility.role: Renders as a div. The collapsible toggle button uses aria-expanded and aria-controls to associate the button with the message list region.
accessibility.keyboard: When the panel is collapsible the chevron button is keyboard-focusable and activates on Enter/Space. No other interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Toggle button exposes aria-expanded (true/false) and aria-controls pointing to the message list id. Variant icons are aria-hidden; the button includes a visually-hidden sr-only label.
accessibility.notes: Variant meaning is communicated through both color and icon shape, so the component does not rely on color alone.

recommendations.description: Pasa múltiples mensajes cuando el análisis produce varios hallazgos. El panel colapsable mantiene el dashboard ordenado.
recommendations.code:
<AiInsight messages={[
  { title: "Servicio al 92%", description: "...", variant: "info" },
  { title: "Flotilla al 78%", description: "...", variant: "warning" }
]} />

recommendations.description: Usa defaultOpen={false} cuando el AiInsight sea secundario en la jerarquía visual del dashboard.
No uses AiInsight para mensajes de confirmación de acciones del usuario. Para eso usa ToasterService.
